text_block_list.text:
Seizing victory and crowned the queen was 
Daiwa Scarlet. She promptly ordered Vodka 
to spend a day working as her personal 
maid.

Embarrassed beyond belief, Vodka flatly 
refused the order. Left with no choice, 
Daiwa Scarlet honestly conveyed her true 
feelings.

Hearing her rival say, "Let's stay rivals 
forever," Vodka recoiled, telling her not 
to get so serious out of nowhere.
